title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local file support for Agent Mode in Excel
description: Extending support for modern Excel workbooks stored on your device to Agent Mode in Excel, giving users the flexibility to use multi-step editing capabilities with Copilot in Excel no matter whether files are stored locally or in the cloud.
